capture_method: Chromium via Playwright against the running application; real modal upload and review, final UI save, REST verification, native map action. No image retouching, injected CSS, mocked responses or fabricated tiles.

Map enabled; Geolocation_url=https://a.tile.openstreetmap.fr. The default geo.circl.lu tile service timed out in the capture environment.

Map data: OpenStreetMap contributors; HOT style: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team; tiles: OpenStreetMap France. Attribution links appear in the chapter.

limitations: The pinned core events/exportModule/gpx_export/17 action returned HTTP 200 application/gpx+xml with zero bytes. The chapter gives the tested attachment-aware API path.
External IP geolocation providers were documented from source, not queried or simulated.
Combined event geographic overview is capped at 200 objects per template. Screenshot uses the dataset map, which reads the full attachment.
No event was published or synchronized. Private local training events remain only on the isolated capture instance.

request_checks: Both modes use events/restSearch with withAttachments=false.
Dataset mode downloads only the selected GPX object attachment through attributes/download.
Point mode issues no attributes/download request and forwards no attachment data fields.
The module payload contains only the selected Object array; no event-level Attribute array or MISP API key is forwarded.
The unrelated attachment ID and sentinel data are absent from the module payload in both cases.
